==About==

Crafting {{i|Candied Oakworth Tart}} at a {{i|Baking Table}} will make {{i|Unleavened Oakworth Tart Dough}} which can then be left to rest inside the Baking Table until it becomes {{i|Leavened Oakworth Tart Dough}}. Leavened Oakworth Tart Dough, when baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}}, will produce Candied Oakworth Tart. Preparing Foods on a Baking Table removes a small amount of [[Insanity]] and has a chance of giving you an {{i|Eloped Gingerbread Man}}. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead. Candied Oakworth Tart is a major [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Vegetables and Greens}} Food Group.
